model_annotation: This chart illustrates the percentage of Gross Domestic Product (BIP) allocated to different levels of public bodies over time. The horizontal axis represents years, ranging from 1991 to 2023, with tick labels at approximately five-year intervals, and is labeled “% des BIP”. The vertical axis represents percentage values, ranging from -0.5 to 3.5, with tick labels at 0.5 intervals, and is labeled “% des BIP”. The chart consists of multiple bar groupings for each year, representing “Bund” (blue), “Länder” (green), and “Gemeinden” (light green) in the left chart, and “Gebietskörperschaften insgesamt” (black) in the right chart. The bars are arranged chronologically by year. A dashed vertical line is present at the year 2000 in the left chart and 1995 in the right chart, with an arrow pointing to a label “Bahnreform²”. In the left chart, the “Bund” bars generally start around 3.0 in 1991 and decrease to approximately 0.2 by 2023, while the “Länder” bars begin around 2.0 in 1991 and fluctuate between 2.0 and 3.0 until 2023, and the “Gemeinden” bars start around 0.5 in 1991 and remain relatively stable around 0.2 to 0.3 until 2023. In the right chart, the “Gebietskörperschaften insgesamt” bars begin around 3.0 in 1991 and decrease to approximately 0.2 by 2023.
